A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SFD research. Their complete main texts, figures, tables, equations, and appendices support comparison, including matching relocated material and the original proof.

before.justification: v1 reports original class-forgetting and celebrity-forgetting experiments, numerical comparisons, training curves, and architecture and guidance ablations.

after.justification: v3 retains original empirical results and adds nudity-forgetting, adversarial-robustness, detector-error, and alternative-distillation experiments.

M1.justification: The original Fisher-based SFD framework remains, but v3 adds substantive adaptations: negative prompting for nudity forgetting, the KL-based SFD-KL objective in Appendix B.8, and SFD+TE incorporating an AdvUnlearn text encoder in Appendix B.7. These extend the method beyond applying unchanged SFD to additional benchmarks.

E1.justification: v3 adds nudity/NSFW concept forgetting on I2P and adversarial-prompt scenarios, extending coverage beyond v1's ordinary class and celebrity forgetting. CIFAR-10, STL-10, Brad Pitt, and Angelina Jolie remain.

E2.justification: Table 1 adds SA to the CIFAR-10 comparison, although SA already appeared in v1's celebrity experiment. New comparisons include SiD-LSG and SiD-LSG-Neg for nudity forgetting, SD v2.1 in Table 7, and FMN and AdvUnlearn-UN/TE in Table 8. The celebrity comparator set is retained under more specific labels.

E3.justification: v3 adds generative Precision/Recall and NFEs, I2P evaluation with ten images per prompt and NudeNet/Q16 detection, CLIP scores, and a 142-prompt adversarial ASR protocol. Table 10 also revises the reported SD score-network learning rate from 1e-6 to 3e-6 and the '#kimgs' entry from 100,000 to 100/300. These reported revisions do not establish that retained experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: Appendices B.6-B.8 add detector false-positive case studies, robustness testing against UnlearnDiffAtk, evaluation of combining SFD with an adversarially trained text encoder, and a Fisher-versus-KL distillation comparison with convergence curves. The existing architecture, CFG, and two-stage analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-training-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. Fixed-seed qualitative comparisons occur in both; the added images per I2P prompt are evaluation samples, not reported independent experimental replications.

E6.justification: Table 1 revises CIFAR-10 Retrain/ESD/SalUn FIDs from 11.69/17.37/11.21 to 7.94/12.68/11.25 and SFD UA from 100.00 to 99.64. New nudity, adversarial, and KL results substantially expand the evidence; Table 8 reports post-attack ASR of 55.63% for SFD and 7.04% for SFD+TE. Celebrity scores and the underlying CFG-ablation values are retained.

T1.justification: Appendix B.8 adds a formal KL-based forgetting objective and its generator-gradient expression, Equations 13-14. The original SFD formulation, Lemma 1, and its proof remain substantively unchanged; the proof moves from Appendix B to Appendix D.

C1.justification: The central contributions of data-free forgetting and simultaneous one-step distillation remain. The introduction narrows the UA claim from significant improvement to competitive performance, while adding an explicit claim of outperforming baselines on celebrity and NSFW forgetting.

C2.justification: v3 adds focused interpretations concerning the difficulty of abstract nudity concepts, detector false positives, and complementary benefits of adversarial text encoders. It acknowledges that ordinary SFD underperforms AdvUnlearn-TE under attack. The original CFG and two-stage interpretations remain, and the generic limitations section is relocated without substantive revision.

D1.justification: v3 adds a project code-access link and detailed nudity-training recipes, including subject lists, keywords, and prompt construction. It newly specifies ten classifier-training epochs, identifies the distilled SD 1.5 checkpoint used for concept forgetting, clarifies SFD-Two Stage labeling, and explicitly documents stop-gradient weighting. These substantially expand reproducibility information without proving changes to previously undisclosed settings.

R1.justification: v3 adds a focused concept-erasure discussion distinguishing sampling guidance from fine-tuning approaches, plus references for generative Precision/Recall and AdvUnlearn. It drops the in-context diffusion citation. Most related work is retained and relocated; additional publication entries for Diff-Instruct and UnlearnDiffAtk correspond to works already cited in v1.

P1.justification: The document is substantially reorganized: related work, dataset and evaluation details, the algorithm, and limitations move into expanded appendices. The main narrative is condensed around method and experiments, with revised introductory claims and a rewritten conclusion. This exceeds simple renumbering.

P2.justification: v3 expands Table 1 with additional columns and UA highlighting, replaces dense class-sample grids with smaller grids, and moves the celebrity figure to the opening page. It adds nudity comparisons, detector examples, and KL convergence displays, while restructuring tables and adopting a different conference layout.

improvement.justification: v3 substantially addresses v1's narrow empirical support for safety-related forgetting through I2P testing, adversarial stress tests, and detector-error inspection. The KL comparison better tests the loss choice, while expanded implementation details improve reproducibility. Table 1 also reconciles SFD's CIFAR-10 UA with the existing ablation. These gains outweigh remaining weaknesses: uncertainty estimates are absent, some setting revisions are unexplained, and the new blanket outperformance claim exceeds the mixed celebrity metric rankings.
